The accumulation of surplus agricultural wealth inside early chiefdoms triggered institutional social inequality. (早期酋邦累積的農業剩餘財富，引發了制度性的社會不平等。)

meaning: adv. 必然地；不可避免地
example: As cities grow, they inevitably take over nearby farmland. (城市擴張時，無可避免會占用附近的農地。)

meaning: vt. 感染；傳染；使受影響
example: The virus can infect both birds and humans, which worries health officials. (這種病毒能感染鳥類和人類，讓衛生官員很擔心。)

meaning: adj. 傳染性的；有感染力的

From the burned bones, archaeologists drew the inference that early humans used fire. (考古學家從燒焦的骨頭推斷，早期人類已經會用火。)

meaning: adj. 較差的；劣等的；下級的

Her book on urban planning became one of the most influential works of the century. (她關於都市規劃的書，成為本世紀最有影響力的著作之一。)

meaning: adj. 非正式的；非正規的；隨意的

The student council initiated a campaign to reduce food waste in the cafeteria. (學生會發起一項減少餐廳廚餘的活動。)

meaning: n. 開始；啟動；入會儀式

Insects make up more than half of all known animal species. (昆蟲占所有已知動物物種的一半以上。)

Sea turtles follow instinct to find the ocean as soon as they hatch. (海龜一孵化就靠本能找到大海。)

meaning: adj. 不可或缺的；構成整體的

The intensity of the storm increased as it moved over warm ocean water. (暴風雨移經溫暖海面時強度增加。)

meaning: adj. 密集的；加強的；集約的

The user interface of the new software is highly intuitive. (這款新軟體的使用者介面非常直觀。)
Loud music can interfere with concentration when students are reading difficult texts. (學生讀艱深文章時，吵雜的音樂會干擾專注。)
The intermediate class is designed for students who already know basic grammar. (中級班是為已經懂基本文法的學生設計的。)
A power cut interrupted the experiment just before the final measurements. (停電讓實驗在最後一次測量前中斷了。)

meaning: n. 間隔；間歇；中場休息

meaning: vi. 介入；干預；介於其間

meaning:

The chemistry lab stays open until ten at night during exam weeks. (考試週期間，化學實驗室開到晚上十點。)
The structural integrity of the skyscraper was engineered to withstand immense lateral wind forces. (這棟高層摩天大樓的結構完整性，經過工程設計能承受巨大的橫向風力。)
The layout of the ancient city shows that streets were planned in a grid. (這座古城的配置顯示街道是按棋盤格規劃的。)
The lecturer posts her slides online so that students can review them before exams. (講師把投影片放上網，讓學生考前可以複習。)

meaning: n. 傳說；傳奇人物；圖例
example: According to legend, the city was founded by two brothers raised by a wolf. (傳說這座城市是由一對被狼養大的兄弟建立的。)

meaning: adj. 合法的；正當的；合理的

meaning: adj. 有責任的；易於……的；可能的

Regular exercise reduces the likelihood of developing heart disease later in life. (規律運動能降低日後罹患心臟病的可能性。)

meaning: adj. 縱向的；經度的；長期追蹤的

meaning:
n. 環；迴路；循環

meaning:
n. 塊；腫塊

meaning: adj. 磁性的；有吸引力的

meaning: n. 規模；大小；重要性；震級

meaning: vt. 操縱；操控；（巧妙地）處理

meaning:
adj. 手工的；體力的；手動的

meaning: adj. 母親的；母系的；母性的

meaning: vt. 使最大化；充分利用

meaning: adj. 機械的；機器的；呆板的

meaning:

meaning:

meaning: vt. 使減到最少；輕描淡寫

meaning: n. 移動能力；流動性；機動性

meaning:

meaning: n. 神話；迷思；錯誤觀念

meaning: adj. 令人不快的；惡劣的；嚴重的

meaning: n. 民族主義；國家主義

meaning: n. 必要；必需品；必要性

meaning:

meaning: n. 節點；結點；（植物的）節

meaning: adj. 名義上的；象徵性的；（金額）微小的
